Bengali separates the field

Switch the script filter: two of three models lose most of their accuracy in Bengali. Hindi-only testing overstates readiness.

Text is a gate

Raters would post 0% of posters whose text they judged wrong, and 61% of those they judged exactly correct.

Read every number with its n

This is a pilot. A cell with fewer than 20 ratings is shown, but should not decide anything on its own.

The poster must show exactly:
Is the text correct?
Would you post it as-is?
Best overall?

Three taps per set

Each rater sees only the script they read. The required text sits above the posters, so judging accuracy is a comparison, not a memory test. A set takes under a minute on a phone.

Blind and shuffled

Model names are hidden and the A, B, C order changes between sets. At scale the order also changes between raters, to remove position bias.

Gold posters keep raters honest

About one poster in ten has a known error. Raters who miss gold errors are coached or removed. In the pilot, non-native readers missed half of the wrong Hindi posters.

Models: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview (Gemini app), Google Gemini 2.5 Flash Image and OpenAI GPT Image 1 (arena.ai, Direct mode). First output only, same prompt for every model. Prototype by Swapnil Ghatak.
